docs.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select and copy the command instead.

create.result: The response is JSON: 201 for a newly created link or 200 for an existing one. Unknown, private, or invalid repositories are rejected.
create.text: POST a complete HTTPS GitHub repository URL. The shorthand command above is the simplest option for terminal use.
create.title: Submit JSON
create.verification: The public POST endpoint requires a fresh Turnstile token from a browser challenge. Set TURNSTILE_TOKEN to that token. A Cloudflare account API token is not a substitute, and verification tokens cannot be reused.

inspect.info: A plus sign after the slug returns the same metadata. Slugs use uppercase base36; keep their case.
inspect.text: Read stored metadata without contacting GitHub. Replace 2 with your slug. The JSON includes the initial and current repository names, destination, state, and verification times.
inspect.title: Inspect a link

docs.intro: Use curl to get a permanent GitHub link, inspect its metadata, or check where it leads. No SDK or account required.

limits.errors: Errors contain a stable error code and a message. Use --fail-with-body to keep the JSON response while making curl exit with an error. This option requires curl 7.76.0 or newer.
limits.known: Looking up an existing repository through the shorthand route does not use the cold-create allowance.
limits.post: POST: 3 requests per minute and 50 submissions per day after URL validation. Failed verification counts toward the daily allowance.
limits.shorthand: Creating a previously unknown repository through the shorthand route: 5 per hour.
limits.text: Limits apply per IP. These are the deployment defaults; an operator can configure different limits.
limits.title: Limits and errors

resolve.redirect: To inspect the normal short-link redirect without following it, print its response headers. Add -L to curl when you want to follow redirects.
resolve.text: The resolve endpoint returns JSON and verifies stale active links against GitHub. If verification is unavailable, it returns an error instead of trusting an outdated destination.
resolve.title: Check the destination

short.explicit: curl is recognized automatically. For another client, send Accept: text/plain or add ?format=text. Opening the same repository path in a browser redirects to its short link.
short.text: Replace smegg99/qr2g.it with owner/repo. A known repository returns its existing address; a new public repository gets one after a GitHub lookup. The response is a plain-text URL followed by a newline.
short.title: Get a short link

status.200: Existing link or successful metadata/resolve response.
status.302: A browser or short link is being redirected.
status.400: The JSON body or repository URL is invalid.
status.403: The repository is private, or Turnstile verification is missing or failed.
status.404: The repository or short link was not found.
status.410: The stored link is no longer active.
status.429: Your IP reached a request limit.
status.503: GitHub, Turnstile, or repository verification is temporarily unavailable.
